root: ^Composed, elegant and discreet, this woman is sitting quietly, her muscular husband standing nearby with a serious face.

s: ^Hi, madam, I'm the train conductor, what's your name?

c-0: ^good afternoon, sir. My name is Irina. Irina Kuznetsova. And this is my husband, Yakiv.
^You see her noding toward her husband, with a polite smile.

s: ^How are you feeling ?
^do you need anything ?

c-0: ^I’m afraid the train does not work well with me. The motion, the noise… I get migraines and a bit sick, I must confess.
c-1: ^You’re considerate, conductor, A rare quality these days. My husband is watching over me, he's a true wingless angel. Thank you, though.

s: ^Don't worry madam, the journey will be shorter than you think.
^where are you from ?

c-0: ^With someone like you to guide us through the mountains I'm sure it will be.
c-1: ^I'm from a small city here in the far East, barely known.

s: ^the far East ? The borders?
^you can tell me it's name, maybe I know about it.

c-1: ^It's hum... Kastsa. A beautiful little city sitting near the flooded lands.

s: ^what's bringing you aboard my train ?

c-0: ^Safety. That’s all anyone seeks now, isn’t it? She touches her scarf as if checking it’s still secure. My husband insisted we leave quickly.

s: ^You seem reluctant.
^your husband seems very protective of you. More than usual I mean.

c-0: ^Leaving behind a life, even a dangerous one, is never simple. It was a hard choice to make.
c-1: ^Yes, he’s protective. Perhaps too much. But the times call for vigilance, and unfortunately,  some people don’t have the luxury of trust anymore.

s: ^do you have any family?
^what kind of job did you do ?

c-0: ^None close. My parents passed years ago. I’ve only… acquaintances.
c-1: ^I worked in differents fields, not very interesting I'm afraid... my husband's a carpenter.

s: ^your husband is a carpenter? Are you sure?
^differents fields, uh? What kind if I may ask?

c-0: ^Yes, I am. Go ask him if you don't believe me !
c-1: ^I... was a musician. Something tick in your brain, but you don't know what.

s: ^so you were an artist? What kind ?

c-0: ^I sang, yes. Folk songs as new ones. I miss it very much.
^Suddenly it strike you : you know her voice. You are pretty sure you heard it through the radio. She's...

s: ^didn't you had songs played on the radio ?

c-0: ^She blushes and stutter I- I mean may-maybe I... you suddenly recognize her : she's the superstar singer Nataliya Honcharova.

IrinaReveal: ^Oh my god you are Nataliya Honcharova !
^Please keep your voice down, I beg of you.

s: ^but... you're a star ! Why do you hide like that ? And here, above all places your money could buy ?

c-0: ^Because since the SRUR took Slava, I was a bird in a golden cage : paid to sing to the devils, trapped in a studios where I could'nt leave but I had everything I wanted. It was safe, sure, but I was no free. Andriy (my bodyguard right here) she point at her "husband" tell me one morning that he found a way for me to flee. I was scared at first, but he convinced me it was for the best.

s: ^don't worry madam Honcharova, I won't tell a thing. Your secret is safe with me.

c-0: ^She hold your hand and look at you in the eyes thank you very much.

s: ^sorry, I think I'm confused. I don't have much of a musical ear, you see.

c-0: ^She looks at you, surprised and relieved at the same time. Oh, hum... well yes it happens sometimes. I'm told have look-alikes all over the country.

s: ^no relatives alive ?

c-0: ^I was a single child, and my parents died in an accident some years ago.

s: ^what will you do once in the neutral zone?

c-0: ^I'll find work, I'm not worry about that. And my husband too, of course.

s: ^Observe

c-0: ^Her hands are delicate and manicured. Her posture is upright, shoulders square even when seated. Her suitcase bears a small emblem, half-scratched away. Sometimes, without even noticing it, she start humming a song with a beautiful voice. You recognize the song being Boskovia's dawn, a hopeful song written and sang in the beginning of the war by Nataliya Honcharova that became very popular across the country.
